events.title: Mind Vessel - Steam Next Fest Gameplay Showcase
events.summary: Hi everyone!A gameplay footage of Mind Vessel will be broadcasted during the week of Steam Next Fest starting on 19 october.The demo will be available during the festival come try it!If you are interested please wishlist the game it helps a lot.

events.title: Steam Next fest - Update 16/10/2026
events.summary: Steam Next Fest 19 october 2026Mind Vessel will be part of the Steam Next fest this October. If you already tried the demo a few weeks/months ago, I invite you to come back and have a look at it because a lot of things have been implemented in a short time.Changes for this updateNew mechanic in 2 Souls difficulty: Mindstones can be perishablesI reworked the structure of the different difficulties in the game with the aim that each difficulty level brings something new. events.summary: New update adding some polish and a quality of life feature for combat.PolishBoss screamBosses will now greet you with intimidating shouts.Heart attackI changed the way losing fights is presented for clarity. events.title: Update 01 / 10 / 2026
events.summary: Hi everyone, I added 2 new boss visuals, they are directly available in the demo.New boss visualsVoid WatcherThe giant spider legs are part of his head, which can be grafted to spirits.PlagueHe adds to the game the possibility of having an eye on the arm, which until then was only possible on the head and body.

events.title: Update 01 / 10 / 2026
events.summary: Hi everyone, so far there were still some placeholders in the demo (several bosses had the same appearance), I finally added the two missing boss visuals.New boss visualsVoid WatcherThe giant spider legs are part of his head, which can be grafted to spirits.PlagueHe adds to the game the possibility of having an eye on the arm, which until then was only possible on the head and body.

events.title: Production update: 12/09/2026
events.summary: Hi everyone, I finally implemented all the soul difficulties in the game. When you win a run at a certain difficulty, you gain 1 soul which gives you acces to the next one. events.title: Patch Notes v0.8 - 28 / 04 / 2026
events.summary: Hi everyone, I want to start by saying thank you so much for trying out the demo of Mind Vessel! I saw some videos and got feedback from you, and I started to work on some issues you encountered, like the attractiveness of hybridizations or the distribution of rooms on the map.New contentThe GraveyardThe priest have now a Graveyard option instead of the Heal.
